title: Listing Publishing Standards and Jurisdiction Registration Table — Roamhaven Listings
content:
# Listing Publishing Standards

A Roamhaven Listings listing is created in draft and is published only when it meets every standard of its space type. A listing failing any standard stays in draft.

## Standards a listing must meet to be published

1. The number of guests the listing accepts is no higher than the space type's guest capacity.
2. The listing has no fewer bedrooms than the space type's bedroom minimum.
3. The listing carries no fewer photos than the space type's photo figure for publishing.
4. The nightly rate lies between the space type's nightly-rate minimum and nightly-rate maximum.
5. The listing title is no longer than the space type's title limit in characters.
6. The cancellation policy is one of the policies on the space type's menu.
7. Where the space type requires smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms have been declared.
8. Where the space type requires professional photography, the photos are professional photographs.
9. In a jurisdiction whose entry below requires registration for the space type's regulatory class, a listing can be published only when a registration number is recorded on it.

## Path to publishing

- A listing of a space type that needs no in-person inspection is published by the host directly from draft, once it meets every standard.
- A listing of a space type that requires an in-person inspection goes from draft to **pending inspection** when the host submits it, and is published only by a passed inspection. The passed inspection publishes it.
- The date the listing first goes live in search is its first listed date.

## Registration numbers

The registration number is recorded exactly as the jurisdiction issued it, and is displayed on the listing where the space type requires the number to be displayed. Whether a registration number is recorded is read from the listing's own record.

## Jurisdiction table

| Jurisdiction | Registration required, hosted space types | Registration required, unhosted space types | Primary-residence rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| Austin (TX-AUSTIN) | yes | yes | no |
| Orange County (FL-ORANGE) | no | no | no |
| Denver (CO-DENVER) | yes | yes | yes |
| Nashville (TN-NASHVILLE) | yes | yes | no |
| Honolulu (HI-HONOLULU) | yes | yes | no |
| San Diego (CA-SAN-DIEGO) | yes | yes | no |

## Applying the registration standard (hypothetical listings)

| Listing | Registration number recorded? | Can be published under the registration standard? |
|---|---|---|
| Private Room in Nashville | no | no — Nashville requires registration for hosted space types |
| Private Room in Nashville | yes | yes, as far as registration goes |
| Entire Home in Orange County | no | yes, as far as registration goes — Orange County requires none |
| Entire Apartment in San Diego | no | no — San Diego requires registration for unhosted space types |
